column3: builds a copy, in a temporary folder, of the style-bearing files the theme-rule check reads (stylesheets, templates, fonts lists) under packages/design, packages/glass-shared/src, apps/workspace/src and scripts, apps/pages and apps/harness/src, and the two sign-in theme files in harness/ by name, with node_modules and dist pruned by name; every plant is written into that copy; the real-tree cases run the check itself over OspreyFlow_Core, which reads the same folders (and packages/themes, absent today)
